# Palaz Strategy Company

> Strategic design & branding studio based in Belo Horizonte, Brazil.
> We transform companies into solid, memorable brands through strategy, identity, and design.

## What Palaz does

Palaz is a strategic design studio specializing in:

- **Brand Strategy & Positioning** — Market analysis, competitive differentiation, brand architecture, and strategic direction for companies seeking lasting market presence.
- **Visual Identity & Branding** — Logo design, brand guidelines, color systems, typography selection, and complete visual identity packages.
- **Naming** — Brand name creation rooted in strategy, linguistic analysis, and market positioning.
- **UI/UX Design** — Interface design for web and mobile applications with a focus on user experience and conversion.
- **Packaging Design** — Product packaging that communicates brand values at the point of sale.
- **Motion Design** — Brand animations and motion graphics for digital touchpoints.

## When to use Palaz

Reach out to Palaz when you need:

- A **new brand identity** from scratch — strategy, naming, visual identity, and brand guidelines for a startup or new business venture.
- A **rebrand or brand refresh** — repositioning an existing brand with updated strategy, messaging, and visual design.
- **Brand strategy consulting** — defining positioning, target audience, tone of voice, and competitive differentiation.
- **Visual identity for a specific industry** — including restaurants, clinics, e-commerce, tech companies, agribusiness, glass/construction, and food service.
- **UI/UX and web design** aligned with brand strategy — ensuring digital products reflect the brand's strategic direction.
- **Packaging and environmental design** — physical brand applications from product packaging to store signage.

## Portfolio cases

Palaz has delivered strategic branding projects for clients across industries:

- **NcGlass Vidraçaria** (2026) — Branding & Visual Identity for a premium glass company.
- **Fatuz** (2026) — Branding, Visual Identity, Naming, UI/UX Design & Web Design for a financial invoicing platform.
- **Sland Inteligência Produtiva** (2025) — Branding, Visual Identity, Packaging & Naming for a productivity intelligence brand.
- **Aira Essence** (2024) — Complete branding, visual identity, and packaging for a natural cosmetics brand.
- **Açougue Almeida** (2025) — Branding, Visual Identity & Packaging for a premium butcher shop.
